title: privacy: /us/usc/t5/s552a/d — release 119-102 excerpt

uslm_source.xml:
<ns0:uscDoc xmlns:ns0="http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://xml.house.gov/schemas/uslm/1.0 USLM-1.0.15.xsd" xml:lang="en" identifier="/us/usc/t5"><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id013902ad-810c-11f1-88fc-c715e7e6606c" identifier="/us/usc/t5/s552a/d"><ns0:num value="d">(d)</ns0:num><ns0:heading> <ns0:inline class="small-caps">Access to Records</ns0:inline>.—</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau>Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords shall—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id013902ae-810c-11f1-88fc-c715e7e6606c" identifier="/us/usc/t5/s552a/d/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:content> upon request by any individual to gain access to his record or to any information pertaining to him which is contained in the system, permit him and upon his request, a person of his own choosing to accompany him, to review the record and have a copy made of all or any portion thereof in a form comprehensible to him, except that the agency may require the individual to furnish a written statement authorizing discussion of that individual’s record in the accompanying person’s presence;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id013902af-810c-11f1-88fc-c715e7e6606c" identifier="/us/usc/t5/s552a/d/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> permit the individual to request amendment of a record pertaining to him and—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id013902b0-810c-11f1-88fc-c715e7e6606c" identifier="/us/usc/t5/s552a/d/2/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> not later than 10 days (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and legal public holidays) after the date of receipt of such request, acknowledge in writing such receipt; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id013902b1-810c-11f1-88fc-c715e7e6606c" identifier="/us/usc/t5/s552a/d/2/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:chapeau> promptly, either—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id013902b2-810c-11f1-88fc-c715e7e6606c" identifier="/us/usc/t5/s552a/d/2/B/i"><ns0:num value="i">(i)</ns0:num><ns0:content> make any correction of any portion thereof which the individual believes is not accurate, relevant, timely, or complete; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
<ns0:clause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id013902b3-810c-11f1-88fc-c715e7e6606c" identifier="/us/usc/t5/s552a/d/2/B/ii"><ns0:num value="ii">(ii)</ns0:num><ns0:content> inform the individual of its refusal to amend the record in accordance with his request, the reason for the refusal, the procedures established by the agency for the individual to request a review of that refusal by the head of the agency or an officer designated by the head of the agency, and the name and business address of that official;</ns0:content>
</ns0:clause>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id013902b4-810c-11f1-88fc-c715e7e6606c" identifier="/us/usc/t5/s552a/d/3"><ns0:num value="3">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:content> permit the individual who disagrees with the refusal of the agency to amend his record to request a review of such refusal, and not later than 30 days (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and legal public holidays) from the date on which the individual requests such review, complete such review and make a final determination unless, for good cause shown, the head of the agency extends such 30-day period; and if, after his review, the reviewing official also refuses to amend the record in accordance with the request, permit the individual to file with the agency a concise statement setting forth the reasons for his disagreement with the refusal of the agency, and notify the individual of the provisions for judicial review of the reviewing official’s determination under subsection (g)(1)(A) of this section;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id013902b5-810c-11f1-88fc-c715e7e6606c" identifier="/us/usc/t5/s552a/d/4"><ns0:num value="4">(4)</ns0:num><ns0:content> in any disclosure, containing information about which the individual has filed a statement of disagreement, occurring after the filing of the statement under paragraph (3) of this subsection, clearly note any portion of the record which is disputed and provide copies of the statement and, if the agency deems it appropriate, copies of a concise statement of the reasons of the agency for not making the amendments requested, to persons or other agencies to whom the disputed record has been disclosed; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id013902b6-810c-11f1-88fc-c715e7e6606c" identifier="/us/usc/t5/s552a/d/5"><ns0:num value="5">(5)</ns0:num><ns0:content> nothing in this section shall allow an individual access to any information compiled in reasonable anticipation of a civil action or proceeding.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
</ns0:uscDoc>
